summary: A standalone eight-wheel steam-locomotive tender at standard gauge (1.435 m): a riveted water tank with a fla… joints locker_lid_l, locker_lid_r, hand_brake, water_hatch, truck_f_axle_0, truck_f_axle_1, …; options livery; sockets socket_coupler_front, socket_coupler_rear, socket_coal.
